The MKM Edit · Care notes

A little care. A lovely routine.

General guidance for looking after hair. The right routine depends on the exact product, texture and construction you choose.

Ask MKM for care instructions for your exact item.

01

Detangle with care

Gently work through tangles from the ends upward, holding the hair as you detangle to limit pulling. Ask MKM which comb or brush suits the exact texture and construction.

02

Keep washing gentle

Follow the guidance supplied with your specific hair. Use lukewarm water and gentle handling, and ask for suitable products and how often to wash before you start.

03

Be mindful with heat

Confirm whether your particular hair and wig construction can be heat-styled. If it can, ask for an appropriate temperature and a protectant. Do not assume every item tolerates the same heat.

04

Dry and store thoughtfully

Let hair dry fully according to its care instructions. Store it away from excessive heat and moisture, with suitable support for wigs where recommended.

05

Give curls a little attention

Detangling and styling vary by texture. Ask how to preserve the pattern of your chosen hair, and avoid vigorous brushing unless the supplier recommends it.

06

Ask before changing the colour

Colouring, bleaching and chemical treatments can change the hair. Confirm suitability with MKM and seek advice from a qualified stylist before applying them.

Always happy to help

A question about your hair?

Include your care questions in an enquiry and confirm the routine for your chosen item.
